Before selling a pack

Only sell material you created or have permission to distribute. Do not upload Cambridge/IB copyrighted past papers, mark schemes, textbook pages or other people's notes without permission. The published app sends AI requests through a server-side function. The AI key must be stored in your hosting provider's environment variables, never in this browser.

Topic mastery

Scores come only from questions you have actually answered. "Mastered" also needs a correct answer at least two days after you last practised the topic.

Exam Examiner

For Cambridge IGCSE, AS & A Level and IB Diploma. Get a breakdown of every marking point, what you missed, feedback on the command word, a stronger answer, and a chance to rewrite yours.

How marks are shown. When you paste the official mark scheme, StudyStarx checks your answer against each line and marks with it. Without one, the mark is clearly labelled an AI estimate with a range. No tool can guarantee the mark an examiner will give.

Am I ready for my exam?

Topic mastery, syllabus coverage, timed mock results, repeated mistakes and how well your confidence matches your accuracy, in one place.

Syllabus topics

List the topics in your syllabus (one per line) so coverage is measured against the whole course, not only what you have practised.

Classes

Students join a teacher's class with a code. Teachers set work and see each student's progress summary: topic mastery, study time, open mistakes and assignments done.

I'm a student

Join with the code your teacher gives you.

When you join, your teacher can see a summary of your progress: topic mastery scores, study minutes this week, number of open mistakes, recent exam-marking scores and which assignments you have finished. Your notes, chats, uploads and answers are never shared. You can leave at any time.
